name: Field Visibility Manager
description: Admin form to hide selected node fields from the add/edit form for chosen roles by setting the form element's #access to FALSE.
project_description:
The module field visibility manager is a lightweight module used to control the visibility of the fields based on roles. There is a configuration form that allows the user to select the visibility of a field for different roles.

After successfully installing the module, go to the URL

 
 /admin/config/field_visibility_manager/adminsettings. 
 There you can see a list of all fields with user roles against them 
 
 . Enable any role against any field and save it.
